clusters.title: Publishing exact release content
clusters.reasoning: These adjacent concepts are two forms of publishing and retrieving exact release content: a container image in ECR and a provenance-linked build file. All recorded prerequisites precede the tile; required external Docker, shell and workflow preparation must also be complete before entry. Keep the ECR digest and authentication procedure separate from GitHub artifact immutability and attestation verification: shared presentation compares publication workflows, not interchangeable tools or guarantees.

clusters.title: From supplied build commands to EC2 deployment
clusters.reasoning: These adjacent concepts cover consecutive delivery responsibilities: selecting CodeBuild phase commands and exported output, then configuring the supplied EC2 CodeDeploy revision, mappings and hooks. Every recorded prerequisite is available before the tile; required external shell, testing and configuration preparation remains an entry condition. The build export and target deployment remain separate steps with separate evidence, and the deployment concept does not require learning the buildspec concept first.

clusters.title: Safe ECR repository operation
clusters.reasoning: Access and retention are complementary controls on the same already-published ECR images: identify who may publish or retrieve them, then preview which digests may expire. Their recorded prerequisites all precede tile entry. Preserve the boundary between identity/repository authorization tests and lifecycle-expiry checks; permission to pull does not establish that a still-needed image survives retention.

clusters.title: Before-and-after fleet execution checks
clusters.reasoning: Both concepts apply to a scoped fleet operation: inspect proposed targets and actions before mutation, then classify target-specific outcomes before selecting follow-up. Their shared remote-command prerequisite is earlier than the tile, and required external fleet/shell preparation must already be complete. Preserve the distinction between limited dry-run permission evidence and actual invocation results; neither concept must be learned to satisfy the other's entry prerequisites.

clusters.title: Recovery rehearsal readiness
clusters.reasoning: These adjacent checks prepare one bounded recovery rehearsal: verify the approved session's identity, lifetime and access, then verify the isolated restoration destination and client traffic. All recorded prerequisites precede the tile, with required external preparation still binding at entry. Session authorization and environmental isolation remain independent readiness checks; neither substitutes for the other and neither depends on learning its neighbor first.

clusters.title: Controlled and evidenced operational response
clusters.reasoning: Approval/stop controls and execution evidence are complementary parts of the same bounded response workflow. Their recorded prerequisites, including action authorization and CloudTrail attribution, are all available before this tile. Keep preventing or stopping an operation distinct from recording what actually executed: the audit record includes failed outcomes and cannot be inferred from approval or intended actions.
